sloka: तस्य इदम् आश्रम पदम् प्रभावाद् यस्य राक्षसैः ।दिक् इयम् दक्षिणा त्रासाद् दृश्यते न उपभुज्यते ॥३-११-८२॥
transliteration: tasya idam āśrama padam prabhāvād yasya rākṣasaiḥ ।dik iyam dakṣiṇā trāsād dṛśyate na upabhujyate ॥3-11-82॥

translations.english: This is his hermitage. On account of his (Agastya's) impact the demons look south but cannot eat the hermits out of fear (for the sage).
